ruins.intro.fall:
* You wake up on a bed of discarded snack wrappers.
* The scent of lukewarm energy drinks fills you with DETERMINATION.
ruins.sign.notice:
* NOTICE FROM RUINS ADMINISTRATION:
* Please do not feed the roleplayers after midnight.
ruins.save.entrance: * The distant hum of dial-up internet fills you with DETERMINATION.
ruins.fur.stage.ears:
* Something is poking through your hood.
* Ears. Soft ones.
ruins.barky.spared: * Barky is lingering nearby, checking his Discord notifications.
ruins.barky.killed: * Only a pile of synthetic wolf fur remains.
